findings.summary: Review receipt timestamps are not bound to trusted time or snapshot freeze time.
evidence: scripts/conversation-disclosure-continuation-contract-v9.mjs:1116 validates only ISO syntax; lines 1184-1190 pass no verifier time.
Adversarial receipts dated before frozenAt or in 2999 both returned zero validation errors.

findings.summary: Review receipt snapshotFileCount and validatorDigest are not semantically bound.
evidence: scripts/conversation-disclosure-continuation-contract-v9.mjs:1097-1136 checks validatorDigest only for SHA-256 syntax and omits both fields from expected bindings.
A receipt with snapshotFileCount=-999 and an unrelated validator digest returned zero validation errors.

findings.summary: External attestation candidate results need not match runner evidence.
evidence: scripts/conversation-disclosure-continuation-contract-v9.mjs:1395-1398 compares candidateResults only when the optional binding is supplied.
scripts/check-conversation-disclosure-continuation-v9.mjs:480-489 omits that binding; arbitrary syntactically valid PASS result digests were accepted.

findings.summary: Final-manifest validation derives trusted references and the pending projection from the final manifest itself.
evidence: scripts/check-conversation-disclosure-continuation-v9.mjs:418-454 captures validator and runner paths selected by the manifest, then reuses them as expected references; line 479 reconstructs the pending manifest from the final object.
A chain with a wrong programId, unrelated validator/runner paths, and a noncanonical attestation path passed attestation, final-manifest, and anchor validation.

findings.summary: Policy programId is not bound to the closed-world program root.
evidence: scripts/conversation-disclosure-continuation-contract-v9.mjs:743-780 requires only a nonempty policy.programId and validates closedWorld independently.
Changing the frozen policy programId, recomputing its canonical digest, and retaining the original closedWorld program root produced zero validation errors.
